label: Slack: Update Message
description: Rewrite a message this app posted earlier (Slack only lets an app edit its own messages). Address it by channel + ts, replace text and/or blocks.

inputs.name: account
inputs.description: The Slack access (wire a SlackAccess node). Needs the chat:write scope.

inputs.name: channel
inputs.label: Channel
inputs.placeholder: The channel id the message lives in

inputs.name: ts
inputs.label: Message ts
inputs.placeholder: The message's timestamp id (from Send Message)

inputs.name: blocks
inputs.label: New blocks
inputs.description: Replacement Block Kit blocks. Text and/or blocks must be provided.
